<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy &amp; Liquidity:</strong> The RBI has maintained its FY26 GDP growth projection at 6.5% while cutting inflation estimates to 3.1%; additionally, the central bank plans to infuse ₹3 trillion into the banking system via OMOs and forex swaps to manage liquidity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNbUFoX0FtdVltQmREWkx3WDkzdHZpR2RwS1NuS1E1ZzRGTVUtWHBuZXVYSnl3TkRmV1A5NC11S2E5dGtRaFpNdjY0QzhXcVg1akZVVHJOcnkxZFh5R3BzUkctek1JTk9BYWdTM2hpaHJQVmFOb1hGTU5tZHFreW90cy1NeE9PbmlaTEVDUXJ5UTBqck4wX1dBNWt2cTBEdjRRbjNnLUxyTE5kQUdla3EyX0h3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Consolidation:</strong> Indian benchmark indices snapped a four-day winning streak as investors engaged in profit booking, though IT stocks provided some cushion against the broader market decline.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Exchange Sector Dynamics:</strong> Shares of BSE and MCX fell by up to 5% following a Jefferies report suggesting that the upcoming NSE IPO will offer a more diversified and dominant market position, potentially altering the competitive landscape for listed exchanges.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Global Market Divergence:</strong> While the Dow Jones reached a record high, the Nasdaq faced pressure from a chip-sector selloff and weak Samsung earnings, influencing sentiment across global markets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
</ul>
